description: This file defines an Android Activity (ContentInfoActivity) that utilizes Jetpack Compose to display detailed content information, including metadata, description, and interactive action buttons with custom focus and navigation behavior for Android TV. It includes composable functions for rendering UI elements and managing focus states, with attention to TV navigation standards.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed info about a media content, including title, metadata, description, and interactive action buttons, designed for Android TV with focus and navigation handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves intent extras, and sets the Compose content to display the ContentInfoScreen.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles back button presses to finish the activity.

methods.name: ContentInfoScreen
methods.description: Composable function that assembles the entire content info UI, managing focus states, layout, and styling.

methods.name: MetaText
methods.description: Helper composable to render small metadata text elements.

methods.name: MetaDivider
methods.description: Helper composable to render a separator between metadata items.

methods.name: Badge
methods.description: Helper composable to render a badge UI element with background color, text, and styling.

methods.name: ActionPillButton
methods.description: Reusable composable for a focusable, pill-shaped button with icon, custom focus visuals, and keyboard navigation handling suitable for TV remote control.
